aria.value: Help text, counter, and visible error message ids, then addon ids
"true" only while an error message is shown

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the input, then the reveal button when present.

focus: The control boundary shows the focus indicator (border in color-focus-ring plus a 1px ring). The reveal button has its own :focus-visible outline.
notes: The required asterisk is aria-hidden; required state is conveyed by the native required attribute.
Errors appear after the first blur by default so users are not interrupted while typing.
The character count is announced through a polite live region only near or over the limit, 750 ms after typing stops.
Password visibility changes are announced (Password shown / Password hidden).
knownCaveats: Screen-reader announcement of the counter and reveal state has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
